title: Statistics Freshness
summary: ANALYZE samples data so the planner can estimate selectivity and choose joins and indexes. After bulk loads or skew changes, stale stats can make a bad index scan look cheap. The operational response is to analyze targeted tables and verify estimates against actual rows.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Statistics Freshness.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
